mapper.select: SELECT t.*, m.material_name, fl.location_name as from_location_name, tl.location_name as to_location_name FROM mes_inventory_transaction t LEFT JOIN mes_material m ON t.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN mes_warehouse_location fl ON t.from_location_id = fl.id LEFT JOIN mes_warehouse_location tl ON t.to_location_id = tl.id WHERE t.material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY t.transaction_time DESC LIMIT 100
